project.name: xander-lab-parent
project.description:
DinQorAI backend monorepo aggregator (V9 §18). The parent is also the Spring Boot dependency-management source, so every module inherits Boot's BOM.
Layout, and why it is not the full V9 §18 tree yet: §18 says "Wave 0 不全仓搬目录": Wave 0 does not move the whole repo. So this commit creates only what Wave 0B needs: libs/ (extracted shared kernels) and apps/core-host/ (the existing monolith, which Wave 1 will register as dinqor-core-host). apps/gateway, contracts/*, infrastructure/* are deliberately absent: they are Wave 1 / Wave 2 deliverables, and the two gates that read them report SKIP until they exist.
Note that the application module keeps artifactId xander-lab-backend on purpose: renaming it would change the built jar name, and the deploy scripts reference the application by that name (scripts/deploy.sh APP_NAME, docker-compose service name).
